_source: explainer.html section 02 'Request Settings' and 'Budgets & Limits' (example values, qwen38-27b, 7 Oct 2026), and the Outcome -> Action table in section 01. Planner choices are marked. Calibrate overrides the measured ones per arm.
_answer_budget_margin: planner choice, 9 Oct 2026: max_tokens for a ticket = calibration answer_tokens_p95 for that ticket x this margin, rounded up to a multiple of 256; the explainer set 800 from a p95 of 273, which is a wider margin, but code answers are longer and more uniform
_length_doublings: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: how many times a cut-off answer doubles max_tokens before the ticket is queued for the planner; Paradox Atlas queued a 36-SVG file after one doubling and the planner wrote it (frontier tokens)
_check_retries: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: worker retries after a failed test before the ticket is queued; each retry costs about ₹0.30, a queued ticket costs frontier tokens
_retry_temperature: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: temperature for retries only; at 0 the worker returned byte-identical files on retry (Paradox Atlas t2)
_max_attempts_per_ticket: planner choice, 9 Oct 2026: hard stop after the named fixes and retries in the outcome table are exhausted
_test_timeout_s: planner choice, 9 Oct 2026: node --test per ticket
_cache_hit_tps_threshold: planner choice, 9 Oct 2026: a call that 'wrote' faster than this many tokens/s is a server response-cache hit (the 48-call arm A calibration showed 42 such calls at >10,000 tok/s); excluded from speed, ttft and gap statistics, counted separately
_first_run_answer_tokens: planner choice, 9 Oct 2026: max_tokens for a ticket when no calibration exists yet; the 'length' outcome doubles it once. After each run the calibration is recomputed from the run's own calls, so this only applies to a model's first run.
_review_gate_threshold: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: the worker model must rate a checklist statement at least this likely to be fine (from its YES/NO logprobs) to close it without the frontier reviewer. Flappy Bird typed-review experiment: 0.85 was the lowest value that missed none of 11 Opus-confirmed problems across 44 labelled statements; 0.8 missed one
_review_gate_risk_open: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: a ticket whose checklist Score ('how likely is a bug the tests would not catch', levels 1-4) is at or above this opens every one of its statements for the frontier reviewer, even confident ones
_review_answer_max_tokens: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: output cap for the typed frontier call (one JSON object per open statement; Flappy Bird used 1,809 for 8 statements)
_review_models: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: default model per reviewer and mode. Typed answers are a small call (Flappy Bird: $0.06), so Opus; the full prose review reads the whole project, so Sonnet (v0.7.2). --model overrides either
_auto_go_inr: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: a run whose estimated worker cost is at or under this many rupees starts without waiting for 'go', so a small build feels like a direct one (Paradox Atlas: 4 tickets ≈ ₹1; the whole Flappy Bird run was ₹1.37). Above it the planner states the estimate and waits.
_first_run_cost_inr: planner choice, 21 Oct 2026: the estimate the planner quotes before any calibration exists (every measured run so far was under ₹2 of worker cost per 6 tickets)
